Subject: Scorecards: Backend Staff SWE - Priya Sharma — please submit by EOD Wed

Team —

Thanks to everyone for interviewing Priya this morning. Quick ask: please drop your completed scorecard in the shared sheet (link below) and attach a short PDF copy of the scorecard to this thread so recruiting has a record. Were using the standard 1-5 rubric across four axes (Technical Depth, System Design, Product Sense, Communication) plus an overall hire/no-hire recommendation and a short risks/strengths bullet list.

Notes on normalization (please follow):
- Use the 1-5 scale consistently; add a 1-line justification for any 1 or 5 to help adjudication.
- If you had a mix of questions (algo + design), split your numeric inputs across the axes; the sheet will calc an average.
- If you have an outstanding concern that would block, mark it under "Critical Risks" in the notes column.

Deadlines: EOD Wed (2027-06-30) for score submission. If you cannot meet that, please reply with ETA.

Tie-break rule proposal: well use the median score across panel to minimize outlier effects; if the median leaves a split decision (e.g., two recommend / two not), I will schedule a 20-minute calibration call tomorrow for a final behavioral follow-up question.

Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcdExampleSharedSheet
Attachment: scorecard-template.pdf (form to fill)

Thanks —
David
